verdict.rationale: Kick documents exporting a Tax Package as a single Excel file and downloading a 'complete year-end financial package,' plus CSV/PDF upload for import — but there is no documented full-data export (all transactions, journal entries, chart of accounts, audit trail) in open formats intended to let a user migrate off Kick entirely. missing for 10: comprehensive full-ledger/data export beyond tax reports, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) export of all transactions and entities, and any migration/portability documentation for leaving the platform.
